runs.monthDirection: The next 30 days are entirely about making the testnet self-service and then putting a specific date and runbook in front of the two organisations that have already asked. Nothing else moves until those two things are done.
priorities: Make the testnet runnable without your engineers present
Deliver a specific date and the runbook to the two waiting organisations
moves: Identify every step in the current environment setup that requires a QuFi engineer to intervene — commands that fail silently, configuration values that live only in someone's head, dependencies that are not yet scripted — and write them down as a gap list.

Work through the gap list and tighten the environment setup: script the manual steps, surface the hidden configuration values, and resolve the QPL onboarding steps that currently require your team to be present.

Write the testnet runbook as a self-service evaluation document: step-by-step setup instructions, the pass/fail criteria the bank's security team already understands, and the exact commands needed to run the verification layer end-to-end without QuFi present.
